items.title: Dell Ups Annual Sales Forecast Again on Rising AI Server Demand
items.title_ko: Dell Ups Annual Sales Forecast Again on Rising AI Server Demand
items.summary_ko: Dell Technologies boosted its fiscal year revenue sales outlook for the third time as the rapid build-out of AI data centers fuels surging server sales. Revenue in the fiscal year ending in January will be about $202 billion, including $78 billion in AI server sales, compared with a September forecast of $192 billion, the Texas-based company said Tuesday in a statement.

items.title: Paul Krugman Weighs In on AI Boom and Nvidia's Huang
items.title_ko: Paul Krugman Weighs In on AI Boom and Nvidia's Huang
items.summary_ko: Nobel laureate Paul Krugman, a City University of New York Graduate Center professor, argues that stock-market performance should not be confused with the health of the broader economy. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Krugman also says the economy shouldn't depend on one executive when asked about Nvidia's Jensen Huang.
